nonNegotiableLaunchRules: No public users until launch gate is open.
No production payment flow until PayFast sandbox and ITN verification evidence pass.
No candidate data writes outside PostgreSQL/Supabase Truth Vault.
No workflow execution without idempotency key, correlation ID, and audit evidence.
No secrets in git, chat, reports, screenshots, or package artifacts.
No branch launch from unprotected main.
No web route may shell out to local workstation runtime as a public API path.
No broad tenant-blind RLS policies for public production traffic.
No production personal data until backup and restore drill evidence passes.
No provider credentials may be printed in logs, reports, screenshots, or frontend code.
No candidate notification provider may send live messages until communications staging proof passes.
No public launch until observability and incident staging proof passes.
No personal data collection or payment flow until legal, privacy, consent, terms, and refund policy proof passes.
No final assembly readiness may open until the staging runtime proof pack is captured and reviewed.
No public launch until the final assembly evidence bundle exists, is redacted, and is founder-reviewed.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Protect main branch and require validators
requiredLaunchGates.remainingConstraint: Apply and verify GitHub branch protection with source-guard required.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Materialize backend API as deployable runtime
PayFast sandbox and ITN evidence
requiredLaunchGates.remainingConstraint: Capture real PayFast sandbox checkout against staging notify URL.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Backup and restore drill
requiredLaunchGates.remainingConstraint: Run real staging backup and restore drill.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Secrets outside Git with masked runtime health proof
requiredLaunchGates.remainingConstraint: Run masked runtime secret health proof.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Email primary and urgent WhatsApp-only boundary
Observability and incident proof
requiredLaunchGates.remainingConstraint: Run staging monitoring, DLQ, alert, redaction, and incident drill proof.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Legal, privacy, consent, terms, and refund proof
requiredLaunchGates.remainingConstraint: Publish/version policy surfaces and capture founder/legal review plus consent/refund smoke proof.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Capture complete staging runtime evidence pack
requiredLaunchGates.remainingConstraint: Run and review all redacted staging runtime evidence reports.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Capture final assembly evidence bundle
requiredLaunchGates.remainingConstraint: Run final assembly evidence collector and founder-review the redacted evidence bundle before public launch.

launchPhases.definitionOfDone: Protected main, launch gate script present, required source-guard status check configured.

launchPhases.goal: Backend, web, DB, and internal control plane run against staging.
launchPhases.definitionOfDone: API health, command intake, workflow result intake, DB writes, web reads, and staging runtime proof pack pass.

launchPhases.goal: Collect reviewed redacted evidence into one final assembly bundle.
launchPhases.definitionOfDone: Final assembly evidence bundle exists, hashes all required reports, and founder review is recorded.

launchPhases.goal: Founder/operator can process real test candidates manually with evidence.
launchPhases.definitionOfDone: 10 end-to-end candidate journeys completed without unsafe writes or missing evidence.

launchPhases.goal: Limited paid pilot under active founder supervision.
launchPhases.definitionOfDone: PayFast proof, communications proof, support process, refund process, secrets runtime proof, backup/restore proof, observability proof, legal/privacy proof, staging runtime proof pack, final assembly evidence bundle, and incident response are complete.

launchPhases.goal: Open public acquisition with capped load.
launchPhases.definitionOfDone: All required launch gates pass and candidate cap is enforced.
